extDescription.message: Add, change or remove HTTP request and response headers. No tracking, no data collection, open source. Imports ModHeader profiles.

pauseTitle.message: Turn all header changes on or off

confirmDelete.message: Click again to delete this profile

hintRequest.message: Sent from your browser to the site. Leave the value empty to remove a header.

hintResponse.message: Sent from the site back to your browser. Leave the value empty to remove a header.

hintFilters.message: Only apply headers on matching URLs (regular expression). No filters = every site.

invalidName.message: Header names can't contain spaces or special characters like : ( ) , ;

invalidValue.message: Values can't contain line breaks or control characters

emptyRemoves.message: Empty value: this header will be removed

badRegex.message: This URL filter isn't a valid pattern, so nothing is applied until it's fixed: $1

applyError.message: Chrome rejected the rules, so nothing is applied: $1

trustLine.message: Nothing leaves your browser. No tracking.

importBody.message: Bring your profiles over from ModHeader or from an Honest Headers backup. Imported profiles are added next to your existing ones.

importStep1.message: If you still have ModHeader somewhere: open it, go to the profile menu and choose Export, then save the JSON file.

importStep2.message: Click “Choose file” below and pick that JSON file.

importStep3.message: Check the profiles in the Honest Headers popup and switch on the one you want.

importDone.message: Imported $1 profile(s) from $2. Choose one in the popup to switch it on.

importBadJson.message: That doesn't look like a valid JSON file.

importNothing.message: No headers or profiles were found in that file.

importFull.message: You already have the maximum of 50 profiles. Delete some first.

importTooBig.message: That file is too large (over 2 MB).

exportBody.message: Save all profiles as a JSON file. You can import it again on another computer.

privacy1.message: Your headers and profiles are stored only in this browser.

privacy2.message: The extension makes no network requests of its own: no analytics, no ads, no remote code.

privacy3.message: It only uses Chrome's built-in rule system (declarativeNetRequest), which changes headers without reading page content.

privacy4.message: The full source code is public, so anyone can check this.

importSkipped.message: Some ModHeader-only settings (for example exclude filters or cookie rules) were skipped — please check the imported profiles before switching one on.

hintExclude.message: Never apply anything to URLs that match these (regex). Exclusions win over everything else.

hintRedirects.message: Send matching requests to another URL. Use \1, \2 for parts captured with ( ). Be careful not to create a loop.

lockedRedirects.message: Redirects are a Pro feature. You can type them now; they start working when Pro is on.

tabOnlyTitle.message: Apply only to the tab that is open now (Pro). Switches off when the tab is closed.

proBody.message: A one-time purchase that adds the tools people pay for in other header extensions. No subscription, no account, no tracking.

proF1.message: Redirects: send a URL to another one (e.g. production script → your local file)

proF2.message: This tab only: test without affecting your other tabs

proF3.message: Request types: apply only to XHR/fetch, pages, scripts/CSS/images or WebSocket

proF4.message: Auto-off timer: never forget a header that is still switched on

proFree.message: Everything else stays free forever: headers, profiles, URL filters, exclusions, import/export and the Alt+Shift+H shortcut.

proOffline.message: The key is checked on this computer only. Nothing is sent anywhere.

proBadKey.message: This key is not valid. Please check it and try again.
